messages:
Maria Chen: quick async — model onboarding + evals
- Did: onboarded vicuna-13b-q4 to staging; ran evals vs prompt_set_2026-03-16; saw 2 regressions (brevity + hallucination)
- Blockers: reg1 flaky, can't repro reliably locally
- Today: triage reg1, open prompt-fix PR, request canary roll once green

Jamal Ortiz: can you paste an example that fails? small repro helps.

Maria Chen: here's one failing example:
```
PROMPT: Summarize the policy below in one sentence.
MODEL RESP: "The policy permits all external data."  <-- hallucination, incorrect
EXPECTED: "The policy restricts external data sharing." 
``` 
Also repro run: `python eval.py --model vicuna-13b-q4 --prompt-file failing.txt --seed 123 --batch-size 8`

model-qc-bot: Regression alert: rouge_avg dropped 4.2% on prompt_set_2026-03-16 (run/2026-03-21/3789). See: https://ci.internal/runs/3789

Hao Li: can you add the failing prompts to the regen bucket and tag the eval with `regression=true`? also include request ids so we can trace in logs.

Samantha (sam): I'll take the prompt PR and do a quick sanity CR. ping @maria when it's up, I'll run canary if CI green :+1:

Maria Chen: thanks. Jamal — can you try repro with `--seed 42 --batch-size 1`? also try `temp=0.0` vs `0.7` (we suspect temp changed in the staging run).

Jamal Ortiz: on it. ETA ~2h. initial check: the run that regressed used temp=0.7, setting temp=0.0 reduces hallucination but changes style. trying to find minimal prompt tweak.

Maria Chen: opened PR with small guardrail tweaks to prompt (PR: https://git/rdw/inference/pull/4286). added unit to eval harness that asserts `contains(expected_phrase)` for this set.

model-qc-bot: Follow-up run complete (run/2026-03-21/3798): After PR applied on staging, regression resolved (rouge_avg delta +0.3%). CI: all checks passed.

Samantha (sam): great — I'll schedule a canary for the vicuna-13b-q4 channel at 17:00 PT. if anyone has objections or wants to test earlier, speak up.

Hao Li: no objections. I'll add a note to the rollout playbook about the temp sensitivity for this model.

Maria Chen: thanks team. if canary passes, let's promote to dedicated pool tomorrow morning. I'll follow up in #eng-ml with final summary.
